summary: Mizuho Financial Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing an additional cash contribution of JPY 2,900,000,000 (planned) to its Board Benefit Trust (BBT) for directors and officers. The trust will acquire up to 350,000 shares of the company’s common stock from the market between July 14-22, 2026. This is a routine stock compensation program funding, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or strategic event are present.
